reviewSteps: Sign in personally to the existing private AIW Site and open the intended payment project. Use the actual focused Chapter 11 case linked to UATC-0197; if no case is prepared, leave case preparation open rather than approving a synthetic fixture.

Inspect the exact repository original and selected passages: version, locator, source hash, permission/use note and contradictions. Confirm only the source facts and reuse rights you can personally substantiate. The prior permission covers this selected pilot material, not the full laptop corpus.

Check independent source review, any required signed release, explicit activation in this project and withdrawal/currentness status. Candidate or unreleased material remains evidence to review, not design authority.

Inspect at least two viable payment handoff options with exact product version, tier, topology, operating model, assumptions and official version-specific source receipts. If that comparison is missing or unsupported, return it to preparation rather than accepting a default recommendation.

Record your own rationale against the confirmed pending-only authorization and current-version race rules. Mark the alternative rejected or deferred and the assumptions still open. Keep workload and response-time targets explicitly not agreed; do not approve invented numbers.

As the second architect, record your own authenticated case assessment, observations and any requested changes. Check traceability to components, interface/data contracts, deployment and actual evidence. Keep focused-case review distinct from whole-project SDD approval; attach no measurement or sign-off that did not occur.
open: Workload, concurrent users, percentile, timing boundary and measurable response-time target are not agreed.
Establish exact permitted originals, passage locators, source hashes and the governed release/project activation evidence for the selected case.
Complete a version-specific comparison of at least two viable handoff options and architect-authored rationale, assumptions and obligations.
Attach an actual case test or observation where available; synthetic gate results do not count as payment operational evidence.
The user offered to act as the second architect: they must sign in and personally record the independent case review. No assistant-authored review or SDD sign-off substitutes for that action.
